_: GOLDEN FIXTURES for prlint.format_pr_body, captured from PYTHON on 2026-10-14.
THE FORMATTER IS THE INVERSE OF THE PARSER, so the strongest test is NOT a hand-written
expectation - it is that a body formatted from a parsed body PARSES BACK to the same headline,
decision and line name. Both are asserted: the byte-for-byte capture against Python, and the
round trip against this port's own parser.
WHY BYTE-FOR-BYTE TOO: `lint format` output is what a lab pastes into a PR. A formatter that
differs in a separator or a trailing newline produces a body that lints differently, and the
difference would show up in a lab's PR rather than in a test.
